couplets.en: Let me look at you, my love.

lines: Tere pyaar bina main reh na sakaan
couplets.en: I cannot live without your love.

lines: Ve, tu paagal kar gayo mainu ve
couplets.en: You have driven me out of my senses.
Let me look at you, my love.

lines: Tere pyaar bina main reh na sakaan
couplets.en: I cannot live without your love.

lines: Ve, tu paagal kar gayo mainu ve
couplets.en: You have driven me out of my senses.
Let me look at you, my love.
For the first time, I lost my heart.
The whole world slipped from my mind.
For the first time, I lost my heart.
The whole world slipped from my mind.

lines: Akh ch jidhar vekhaan, aave mainu nazar
couplets.en: Wherever I look, I see you.

lines: Te tu paagal kar gayo mainu ve
couplets.en: You have driven me out of my senses.
Let me look at you, my love.
I will give you love in return for love.
For one glance, I would give my life.
I will give you love in return for love.
For one glance, I would give my life.

lines: Tenu yaad karaan, raat jaag guzaaraan
couplets.en: I lie awake at night thinking of you.
